description: The chart illustrates the comparison of MVS and 1-MVS values across different categories and models, specifically within the context of Health and Nutrition, Logistics, and Personal Finance. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with model names (70B llama, 8B llama, 70B llama) repeated across the three main categories, while the vertical axis is labeled with a scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The chart is divided into eight stacked bars, each representing a combination of a category and a model, with the bars colored in green for MVS and blue for 1-MVS. The MVS values range from approximately 0.35 to 0.6, with the lowest value observed in the Health and Nutrition category for both 70B llama and 8B llama models, and the highest value in the Personal Finance category for the 70B llama model. The 1-MVS values complement the MVS values, summing up to 1.0 for each bar, and are represented by the blue portion of the stacked bars. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the distribution of MVS and 1-MVS values across different categories and models.
